articles.title: Netflix's Musafir Cafe Has Viewers Hunting for a Real Cafe in Uttarakhand
articles.excerpt: Vikrant Massey's romantic drama, set in Mussoorie's misty hills, has sparked a wave of fans searching for the show's mountain cafe — but the truth is more complicated than a Google Maps pin.
articles.nri_angle: The show taps into the diaspora's romanticised longing for Indian hill-station life and the idea of escaping to a simpler world in the mountains.
